display.purpose: H1/H2 headings, list-item and quote titles, oversized index numerals.

shadows.name: portrait-drop
shadows.purpose: Under the CutoutPortrait silhouette; follows alpha shape, not a box.

motion.name: ease-editorial
motion.purpose: Ease-out-expo used by every authored transition: reveal, spine draw, signature stroke, nav underline.

motion.name: reveal
motion.purpose: One-shot scroll reveal via IntersectionObserver, staggered ~110-150ms per sibling.

motion.name: spine-draw
motion.purpose: Processo's connecting line between two step numbers, scaleY 0 to 1.

motion.name: signature-stroke
motion.purpose: CTA heading's hand-drawn underline, pathLength=1 draw-in.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Solid gold CTA — WhatsApp/consultation conversion actions.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.5rem; min-height: 2.75rem; padding: 0 1.5rem; border-radius: 6px; background: #CA884E; color: #051B32; font-family: 'Inter Variable', sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; text-decoration: none; transition: background-color 0.2s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: color-mix(in srgb, #CA884E 90%, transparent); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #CA884E; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Outline Inverse Button
components.description: Secondary action on navy surfaces (e.g. 'Enviar e-mail' beside the primary WhatsApp CTA).
components.css: .ds-btn-outline-inverse { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 2.75rem; padding: 0 1.5rem; border-radius: 6px; border: 1px solid rgba(251,248,244,0.6); color: #FBF8F4; background: transparent; font-family: 'Inter Variable', sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; text-decoration: none; transition: background-color 0.2s; } .ds-btn-outline-inverse:hover { background: rgba(251,248,244,0.1); }

components.name: Framed Photo
components.description: Documentary photograph with an offset gold rule-frame and neutral mounted-print shadow.
components.css: .ds-framed-photo { position: relative; width: 260px; aspect-ratio: 4 / 5; } .ds-framed-photo__frame { position: absolute; bottom: -12px; right: -12px; height: 100%; width: 100%; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid rgba(202,136,78,0.5); } .ds-framed-photo__img { position: relative; height: 100%; width: 100%; border-radius: 8px; background: linear-gradient(160deg, #2c3f52, #0f2438); box-shadow: 0 20px 45px -22px rgba(0,0,0,0.5); }

components.name: Cutout Portrait
components.description: Background-removed portrait floating on a navy mounting plate; used only in Hero and ProvaSocial.
components.css: .ds-cutout { position: relative; width: 240px; aspect-ratio: 4 / 5; } .ds-cutout__plate { position: absolute; inset: 2.5rem 1.5rem; border-radius: 1.75rem; background: #051B32; } .ds-cutout__figure { position: relative; height: 100%; width: 100%; filter: drop-shadow(0 35px 50px rgba(0,0,0,0.38)); background: radial-gradient(circle at 50% 35%, #d9a26f 0 22%, transparent 23%), linear-gradient(180deg, transparent 45%, #f2e6da 46%); background-size: 100% 100%; }

narrative.overview:
The site reads as a formally bound legal dossier translated to screen, not a law-firm marketing template. Its structural vocabulary comes from the physical grammar of contract work: a letterhead rule under the header, mounted-print offset frames behind documentary photographs, a table-of-contents-style index for the services list, and portraits background-removed and set on navy mounting plates like a formal portfolio print. Numerals and rule lines stand in for the marginalia of a paper document — margin ticks, a running folio, an index number — rather than decorative UI chrome.

The palette and type pairing (navy/gold/cream/blush, Playfair Display + Inter) are locked, pre-existing brand commitments; this system does not change them. What it changes is composition and craft: asymmetric layouts over centered symmetric grids, an index list over icon-in-circle cards, one restrained motion grammar (scroll reveal, a hand-drawn signature stroke, a spine line connecting process steps) instead of no motion at all.
keyCharacteristics: Editorial-dossier composition: mounted-print photo frames, index lists, letterhead rules.
Two photo treatments only: full-frame documentary shots (offset frame) and background-removed cutouts (navy plate) — cutouts reserved for Hero and ProvaSocial only.
One eyebrow label in the whole page (the Hero's brand tagline) — every other section leads with its heading directly.
Motion is one-shot scroll-reveal plus a small number of named signature moments, never per-element decoration.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Gold is the only chromatic accent on the page. Every other color is navy, cream, blush, or a neutral derived from them.

rules.name: The Neutral Shadow Rule
rules.body: Every shadow uses neutral black (rgba(0,0,0,…)), even on navy surfaces, to avoid a chromatic-glow read.

rules.name: The One Eyebrow Rule
rules.body: The tracked-uppercase-label device appears exactly once, as the Hero's brand tagline. Applying it to every section is unexamined grammar, not a deliberate accent.

rules.name: The Earned Shadow Rule
rules.body: Shadow appears only where something is physically lifted off the page — never as generic card elevation.

dos: Do keep shadows neutral black even on navy surfaces.
Do drive all motion with transform/opacity, never width/height/padding/margin.
Do wrap scroll-triggered elements in Reveal (or the raw data-reveal/useInView primitives) so prefers-reduced-motion disables everything from one place.
Do reserve CutoutPortrait for the two confirmed background-removed portraits only.
donts: Don't add a tracked-uppercase eyebrow label above a section heading beyond the Hero tagline and the two Servicos group labels.
Don't reintroduce icon-in-a-colored-circle cards for lists of 3+ similar items.
Don't change the locked palette, font pairing, or logo lockup.
Don't fabricate credentials, statistics, testimonials, or contact details.
